rawFindings.title: Cached params no longer restore app.param mutations across matching routes
rawFindings.explanation: When the same route param value is encountered again later in the same request, this branch skips re-running the param callbacks but also leaves `req.params[name]` as the new layer's raw captured value. Since `req.params` is replaced for each matching layer, mutations made by an earlier `app.param()` callback are lost for subsequent routes with the same param value.
rawFindings.suggestion: Cache the mutated `req.params[name]` after param callbacks run and restore it before returning from the cached-param branch.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: With `app.param('user', (req,res,next,user) => { req.params.user = 'loki'; next(); })`, two `GET '/:user'` routes where the first calls `next('route')`, a request to `/bob` reaches the second route with `req.params.user === 'bob'` instead of the expected mutated value `'loki'`.
